title: Concept: SHA-1 selected by name (java) — review required
description: In java, naming SHA-1 (getInstances*(s*"SHA-1") requests a deprecated digest. Name-selected digests hide inside factory calls, so reviewers must check the string. The java-specific remedy is selecting "SHA-256".
applicability: java codebases selecting digests by name; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Forged digests where security is assumed; LOW default severity, raised when the digest guards trust.
